about_the_game:
"WAR CROWNING ANDBLEEDING ANIMALS" is a story-driven RPG\AVG adventure game from a female perspective. Players will take on the role of a protagonist embroiled in a power struggle and write their own destiny in a kingdom full of intrigue and choices.

The game immerses players in an epic story about ambition, morality and governance through rich narratives, exploration, puzzle-solving and strategic dialogue. Within the game, players need to navigate among various forces, influence the plot's direction through key decisions, and uncover the secrets behind the kingdom. You can explore beautifully hand-drawn scenes, solve intricately designed puzzles, and interact with numerous characters with distinct personalities - their fates will change due to your choices.

The core of the game lies in the choice of power: to ascend the throne and become an eternal ruler? Or to break the shackles and lead the kingdom towards an unknown future? Every decision made by the player will trigger far-reaching chain reactions.

The game demo offers an immersive experience of 1 to 3 hours, featuring multiple story branches and endings, ensuring a different experience each time you play. The unique female perspective narrative, in-depth character development, and exclusive original soundtrack jointly create a fantasy world full of emotions and tension. If you enjoy themes of plot-driven, moral choices, and power struggles, then "WAR CROWNING ANDBLEEDING ANIMALS" will bring you an unforgettable adventure.

content_descriptors.notes: In some character plots, there will be voluntary invitation-based sexual behaviors, with only textual descriptions and no visuals. Once clearly refused, they can be stopped without causing any loss of character affection.
